cases.area: 视觉响应式与可访问性

cases.limits: Visual spacing, contrast, breakpoint behavior, keyboard-only traversal, focus order, screen reader output, reduced-motion and zoom were not tested because browser screenshot/AX channel was unavailable in this sub-agent.

cases.evidence: Public health, curriculum/catalog, chapter identity, retrieval/recommendation, clarification/no-match and auth boundary passed over current remote HTTP deployment.
cases.limits: Final UI/UX and product acceptance requires independent browser evidence for live rendering and interactions; authenticated task/record paths were not exercised. Therefore the full product cannot be marked final-success from this run.

conclusion.reason: 当前远程 HTTP 契约与内容检索路径可重复通过，但没有独立浏览器渲染/交互证据，且账户绑定任务、恢复、题库复习自评和 P01 提交未使用隔离账户实测。不能把静态源码或工程自检当作最终 UI/UX 与产品通过。
